name: Build Robot
description: The Techie can build a remote-controlled Tiny or Diminutive robot programmed with one skill (Computer Use, Demolitions, Disable Device, Listen, Repair, or Spot) he has ranks in, built through a Wealth check, a Craft (mechanical) check for the frame, a Craft (electronic) check for the electronics, and a Computer Use check to program it.
